title: Fan-Out Runner with Ordered Outcomes and Fail-Fast
instructions: Implement `Outcome` and `run_all` in `fanout.py`. `Outcome` is a frozen, slotted dataclass with an `ok` property. `run_all` runs `fn` over the items on a `ThreadPoolExecutor`, returns one `Outcome` per input in input order, captures exceptions instead of raising, and with `fail_fast=True` cancels work that has not started.

evidence.label: Returns outcomes in input order even if tasks finish out of order
Captures exceptions in Outcome.error instead of raising
Runs every item when fail_fast is off
fail_fast cancels queued work but lets running tasks finish
Handles empty input and one-shot generators
Honours max_workers and runs tasks in parallel
Outcome is a frozen, slotted dataclass with a read-only ok property
